ai_overview.observation: A live SerpApi capture (27 September 2026) confirmed a Google AI Overview renders for 'leased line cost uk' (BroadbandPicker not cited; cited domains: amvia.co.uk, business.bt.com, comparenet.co.uk, coreitech.co.uk, leased-line-comparison.co.uk, leasedlineandmpls.co.uk, mybusinessdeals.co.uk, netify.co.uk, selectra.co.uk -- two of which, amvia.co.uk and selectra.co.uk, were already used as sources on this page before this build) and for 'business leased line cost uk' (present, no domains resolved). The AI Overview text stated a general £130-£700/month range and explained the 'bearer size vs ordered speed' concept using a '100Mbps on a 1Gbps bearer' example. Ofcom's own jargon buster (re-checked 27 September 2026) does NOT define 'bearer', so this specific concept could not be verified there; instead it was independently verified directly against BT's own BTnet page, which literally advertises '30 or 50 Mbps over a 1Gbps service' -- the exact real-world example already sitting unexplained in this page's own price table -- so the concept was added with that primary-sourced example rather than the AI Overview's generic one. One new competitor domain named in the AI Overview citations, leased-line-comparison.co.uk, was independently fetched and verified to publish a genuinely distinct, per-bandwidth price range; it has been added to the page's three-way cost-comparison table. The other newly-seen citation domains (comparenet.co.uk, coreitech.co.uk, leasedlineandmpls.co.uk, mybusinessdeals.co.uk, netify.co.uk) were not independently checked within the available time and are not used as sources.
